data.long_meaning: The name Jari is derived from the Arabic word 'jarara', which means 'to be gentle, soft or tender'. This name carries a sense of compassion, kindness and tenderness. It is also associated with the concept of being easy on oneself and others, making it an ideal name for a nurturing and caring personality. The name Jari carries the meaning “Gentle, Soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jari usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
